note: Reviewer and producer keys this verifier will accept. A key that is not listed here is not an authority: an envelope signed by it is undeterminable, never passed. Registration is a deliberate Lane B act; a key that first appears inside the document it authenticates proves nothing, because anyone able to write the document can also mint the key.

independent-reviewer-key.note: Historical acceptance authority for the M-4, M-5b, M-6 and M-6.5 acceptances that predate this trust root. No private key for it exists on disk, so acceptances cannot be re-issued under it; it stays registered so those historical envelopes remain checkable, and new acceptances use aether-evidence-reviewer-1.

aether-evidence-reviewer-1.note: Acceptance authority for bundles published from Order 10 onward. Generated out-of-band by tools/runners/keygen_evidence_key.py and registered here before any evidence was signed against it; the private key is held outside the repository.

dev-a-operator.note: Lane A producer key, supplied by Lane A and verified here against the candidate-05 bundle it signs. Registering a producer key is lower-stakes than registering a reviewer: a producer attests to its own run, while a reviewer attests to someone else's, so reviewer entries are added only by the verifying lane.

dev-b-key.note: Identity is known; no published key. Same disposition as dev-a-operator.

dev-b-evidence-1.note: Lane B producer key. Distinct identity and key from every reviewer entry above.

dev-a-evidence-1.note: Lane A producer key for the RF-95 candidate-06 re-execution. Supplied out-of-band by Lane A as a public key only; no private key for it exists in this repository. Registered here before the evidence it signs was published, which is the whole point: a key that first appears inside the document it authenticates proves nothing.
